subject: E-Commerce
title: Voice Commerce Revolution
description: A short lesson to help you apply Voice Commerce Revolution.

hook.text: 'Alexa, reorder laundry detergent.' Voice commerce was supposed to be huge. It's still just 2% of online sales.

buildup.text: Smart speakers are in 35% of US homes. Amazon, Google, and Apple all built voice shopping into their assistants.

discovery.text: People use voice for simple reorders and grocery lists but refuse to buy expensive items without seeing them first.

twist.text: Voice shopping eliminates product comparison. When Alexa picks your detergent, it picks Amazon's private label brand.

climax.text: Voice commerce works for reorders but fails for discovery. Without visuals, shopping feels too risky for anything new.

punchline.text: 35% have speakers, 2% buy by voice. Voice works for habits, not browsing.

quiz.question: Why has voice commerce remained at only 2% of online sales?
options: People won't buy expensive or unfamiliar items without seeing them first
